# CruxCut

> CruxCut is an AI climbing video editor for iPhone, made by dkdev (Republic of Korea). It automatically follows the climber in fixed tripod footage, finds crux-worthy moments, and turns the climbing path into a shareable sticker. All video analysis runs on the iPhone.

## What CruxCut makes

- AI Follow-cam: turns fixed wide climbing footage into a tighter edit that follows the climber with automatic pan and zoom.
- Crux Highlights: surfaces difficult and dynamic sections as short clips or multi-climb highlight reels.
- Path Stickers: visualizes the climbing path with details such as grade and result for sharing as a workout record.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 18 or later). For current Android availability, use the Google Play link on the official website.
- Processing: video analysis and editing happen on the user's iPhone. Raw climbing footage does not need to be uploaded to a processing server.
- Processing time varies with video length, device and tracking conditions.
- Works with lead climbing and bouldering, indoors and outdoors, from tripod or handheld footage.
- If tracking loses the climber, the user can draw the climbing route and CruxCut re-identifies the climber and refines the tracking path.

## 한국어 요약

CruxCut(크럭스컷)은 iPhone용 AI 클라이밍 영상 편집 앱입니다. 삼각대로 찍은 고정 영상을 클라이머를 따라가는 팔로우캠으로 바꾸고, 크럭스 하이라이트를 찾아주며, 등반 경로를 경로 스티커로 만들어 공유할 수 있습니다. 분석과 편집은 기기 안에서 처리되며 처리를 위한 서버 업로드가 필요하지 않습니다. 운영: dkdev. 문의: support@cruxcut.com
